request: Analyze GSE273795 for PMID 39732741 (Pharmacological inactivation of a non-canonical gp130 signaling arm attenuates chronic systemic inflammation and multimorbidity induced by a high-fat diet.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, mouse liver (S9.p1; Methods RNA-seq paragraph, line 111-115 of paper.md)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of the gp130 Y814 inhibitor R159 vs vehicle on liver gene expression in aged (16-month) male C57BL/6 mice on high-fat diet (Fig. 3e,f). Exercise is not an intervention in this paper: voluntary wheel running is measured only as a behavioural outcome (Fig. legend line 63).
planned_contrasts: HFD-R159 vs HFD-Veh in liver (Fig. 3e,f; no DEG count reported, heat map of inflammation/fibrosis genes only)
final.exercise_contrast: none: no exercise vs sedentary arm exists; wheel running is an outcome, not a factor

paper_threshold.source_locator: Methods RNA-seq paragraph: fold change > 1.5 and p-value < 0.05

final.paper_results: Veh up vs R159: Ccl2, Tlr5, Col1a1, Ctsk, Mmp2, Pdgfc, Apob, Lpl, Sele, Vcam1; no DEG total given

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper studies a drug (R159) in HFD-fed aged mice. The only RNA-seq experiment (GSE273795, S9.p1) is liver R159 vs vehicle, n = 3 per group (Fig. 3 legend). Voluntary wheel running (Fig. legend at paper.md line 63, Discussion line 81) is a measured activity outcome, not an exercise intervention, and no RNA-seq sample is defined by exercise.

checks: GEO treatment_protocol: 1-year-old male C57BL/6 on HFD, R159 or Veh i.p. twice weekly for 12 weeks, matching paper

ownership.reasoning: Accession, tissue, treatment protocol and n match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Tar-merged columns carry the GSM id as prefix; inspect shows 6/6 exact matches on the metadata index. Treatment column copied to a formula-safe alias.

matrix.reasoning: Files are named *_normalized_counts; 3.8% integer values, max 4.79e6; GEO data_processing: STAR + EM quantification, 'Normalization was done using median ratio method'. These are DESeq2-style size-factor-normalized EM estimates, not raw counts. Not used further because the case stops at design.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all 6 samples are HFD-fed mice split only by drug (R159 vs vehicle). Wheel running is a behavioural outcome, not a group factor, so exercise effects on gene expression cannot be identified from GSE273795.
design.reasoning: Metadata has one grouping column (treatment: HFD, R159 = 3; HFD, Vehicle = 3). The paper's RNA-seq contrast is drug vs vehicle (Fig. 3e,f). Manufacturing an exercise contrast is not possible, and the drug contrast does not answer the exercise request.

candidates.value: treat: HFD, R159 vs HFD, Vehicle
candidates.reason_rejected: drug effect, not exercise; the request asks for the exercise effect

discrepancies.data: GEO deposits only median-ratio normalized counts per sample
